lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：它可能只是来体验一下排队，很多东西在食堂都会排队。
lines.voiceTextEn: Maybe it only came to experience the queue. Many things end up queuing in a cafeteria.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：因为你现在需要钱，而它们需要劳动力。
lines.voiceTextEn: Because you need money, and they need labor.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：它看起来不像纸条会吃的东西，虽然纸条也不该吃东西。
lines.voiceTextEn: That does not look like something a paper slip would eat. Admittedly, paper should not eat at all.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：不是，是一份比较真实的早饭。
lines.voiceTextEn: No. It is merely a disappointingly real breakfast.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：纸包鸡。我知道的至少前两个字很有嫌疑。
lines.voiceTextEn: Paper-wrapped chicken. At least the first word is suspicious.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：一份线索。鸡只是包装。
lines.voiceTextEn: One clue. The chicken is only packaging.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：这份粥很热，但线索很冷。
lines.voiceTextEn: The congee is hot. The clue is cold.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：请不要拓展世界观。
lines.voiceTextEn: Please do not expand the worldbuilding.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitleZh: 纸条撞回食堂，掉下一点蓝光。
lines.voiceTextEn: The paper crashes back into the cafeteria and sheds a flicker of blue light.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitleZh: 纸条急了，它开始不尊重取餐流程。
lines.voiceTextEn: The paper is getting desperate. It has stopped respecting the pickup procedure.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：自助服务发展到这一步，我有点害怕。
lines.voiceTextEn: Self-service has advanced too far. I am mildly concerned.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitleZh: 纸条沿主干道飞走。
lines.voiceTextEn: The paper flees along the main road.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：你正在以“没吃早饭的人类速度”移动。
lines.voiceTextEn: You are moving at the speed of a human who skipped breakfast.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：它没有绩点负担。
lines.voiceTextEn: It carries no grade-point burden.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：这句话在本游戏里出现频率太高了。
lines.voiceTextEn: That sentence occurs far too often in this game.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitleZh: 旁白：失败得很慷慨。
lines.voiceTextEn: A remarkably generous failure.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：这场演出本来也没什么逻辑。
lines.voiceTextEn: This performance never had much logic to begin with.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：whooooo！
lines.voiceTextEn: Whooooo!

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：哦，可能纸类之间有一些我们不懂的关系。
lines.voiceTextEn: Perhaps paper has relationships we do not understand.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：不知道。它这次没有沿路掉纸屑。
lines.voiceTextEn: No idea. This time it left no paper scraps along the road.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：老办法，发个论坛问问。
lines.voiceTextEn: Use the old method. Ask the campus forum.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：CC98 提供了一个非常精确的范围：不是厕所。
lines.voiceTextEn: CC98 has provided a highly precise range: not the restroom.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：意思是它现在比我们更艺术。
lines.voiceTextEn: It means the paper is currently more artistic than we are.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：恭喜，你完成了一次校园级猜谜。
lines.voiceTextEn: Congratulations. You have completed a campus-scale guessing game.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：准确来说，是在倒影里。
lines.voiceTextEn: More precisely, it is inside the reflection.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：对不会游泳的人来说区别很大。
lines.voiceTextEn: For someone who cannot swim, the difference is substantial.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：它又消失了。
lines.voiceTextEn: It disappeared again.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：通常这里不应该有给我们指指路的牌子吗？
lines.voiceTextEn: Should there not be a sign around here to point us somewhere?

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：这就是它躲藏的地方，哈
lines.voiceTextEn: So this is where it is hiding. Hah.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：把它挂到哪里去，让大家看看！
lines.voiceTextEn: Hang it somewhere public. Let everyone see it.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：就是这个假的
lines.voiceTextEn: Use the fake one.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：因为它不能接受别人替它逃跑。
lines.voiceTextEn: Because it cannot tolerate someone else escaping in its place.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：你只是让湖更有氛围了。
lines.voiceTextEn: You have only made the lake more atmospheric.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：还在嘲笑你的倒影。
lines.voiceTextEn: It is still mocking your reflection.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitleZh: 纸条从湖面倒影弹出来，贴着地面飞。
lines.voiceTextEn: The paper springs out of the lake reflection and skims along the ground.

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：现在！它回到浅色模式了！
lines.voiceTextEn: Now! It is back in the light layer!

lines.speaker: system
lines.subtitleZh: 系统：能抓了！
lines.voiceTextEn: You can catch it now!
